blueprint.description: Word guessing hangman game with categories — an interactive game tool with a visual interface.

  • hangman-game · GitHub Topics · GitHub
    The project leverages a combination of models and methods to predict missing letters in a word, enhancing the Hangman gameplay experience. The core methodologies include a Bidirectional LSTM (BiLSTM) 
  • Top 10 hangman Open-Source Projects - LibHunt
    Which are the best open-source hangman projects? This list will help you: dotnet-console-games, Discord-Trivia-Bot, cli-games, python-projects, hangman-game, hang-movie-man, and words.
  • ⭐22 clarkeben/Hangman-Game: A simple hangman word game using Swift for iOS.
  • ⭐18 venkat-0706/Hangman-Game-Python: Hangman is a word-guessing game. The computer selects a random word, and the player tries to guess it letter by letter. The player has a limited numbe
  • godot (gaming): Your open-source game engine
  • gdevelop (gaming): Free and easy game maker

Use these as inspiration for designing the app architecture.
